justification: Wollongong's DCP chapters were read but could not serve: with no applicability config every row would apply to every development type (no_config, DQ-105). This adds the config, each scope quoted from the chapter's own PDF.

pre_impl.existing_data: No database writes. Read the scope section of all 6 active Wollongong chapter PDFs; Wollongong zones from lep_zone_coverage: R1-R5, C1-C4, E1-E5 and others.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: The 2009 DCP says 'E4 Environmental Living'. Since the 2023 NSW zone reform that zone is C4, and E4 is General Industrial.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Same shape and matching as the Hornsby and Campbelltown configs; registered in COUNCIL_CONFIGS like them.
pre_impl.external_source_error: A chapter key that does not match its document_id resolves to nothing; a test checks every active Wollongong chapter has an entry.
pre_impl.frontend_type: No frontend change; the served route already filters on v2_applicable_zones and v2_applicable_dev_types.
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: A wrong zone code would hide or misapply dwelling controls; E4 would have bound them to industrial land. The test pins C4 and rejects E4.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: a Wollongong chapter has no entry, an entry is empty, or residential scope names E4 or omits a residential zone
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Before the config the Wollongong document_ids resolved to None (no_config).

functions.name: WOLLONGONG_CONFIG
functions.input: Looked up by the applicability tagger from each row's document_id chapter part.
functions.output: Zones, development types and layer for each of the six active Wollongong chapters, quoted from their scope sections.
functions.if_none: A chapter missing from the map resolves to None and its rows fall back to no_config.

values.name: B1 residential zones
values.value: R1 R2 R3 R4 R5 C4
values.why: Chapter B1 applies to all residential zoned land including (old) E4 Environmental Living, now C4.
values.source: Wollongong DCP chapter B1 s1, read 2026-09-25

break_it.scenario: The config copies the DCP's own zone code E4 for Environmental Living
break_it.what_happens: Dwelling controls would apply to General Industrial land and vanish from C4 land.
break_it.how: C4 is declared, and a test asserts E4 is absent from the residential scope.

break_it.scenario: A chapter states no scope at all, like E6 Landscaping
break_it.what_happens: An empty entry would collapse back to no_config while looking configured.
break_it.how: E6 keeps its layer key so the entry is truthy and resolves to config_silent.

break_it.scenario: A chapter key in the config does not match the stored document_id suffix
break_it.what_happens: The entry is never reached and every row of that chapter stays no_config while the file looks correct.
break_it.how: Tests resolve each real Wollongong document_id through the tagger and check every active chapter has an entry.

post_merge.manual_verify: After the Wollongong chapters are approved and committed, the commit's enrichment tags them with this config; check no Wollongong row is no_config.
